description: Event catalogue for the APP Fraud Detection and Reimbursement journey. Introduces 9 new events: EVT-090 through EVT-098. Events span four topics: fraud.cases, fraud.decisions, fraud.reimbursements, fraud.recovery, and fraud.patterns. Financial and restricted events are routed to the WORM audit pipeline (SVC-111) with 7-year retention per NFR-005-DATA-001 and PSR PS23/3.
catalogue_principles: All event names are in past tense (domain event naming convention)
Fraud scores, investigation notes, and internal model features must never appear in event payloads — tipping-off risk and model IP protection
gross_negligence_evidence text must NOT appear in any event payload — stored encrypted in SVC-013 internal storage only
FraudPatternDetected payload is PII-free by design — pseudonymised case_id and anonymised feature vector only

events.name: FraudCaseCreated
events.trigger: SVC-013 creates a new FraudCase entity. Triggered by two paths: (1) SVC-017 calls POST /fraud-cases when PER-001 submits a fraud report via mobile app (CH-002) or telephone (CH-004); (2) SVC-013 auto-creates a case on consumption of PaymentFraudBlocked (EVT-P08) from SVC-001. The event is published after the FraudCase is persisted and a case_reference is assigned.

payload_schema.payment_intent_id: string (UUID v4) | null — null for cases without an identified payment
payload_schema.fraud_typology: string enum — typology classification; null for realtime_block
payload_schema.total_loss_amount: number — 0.00 for realtime_block; estimated loss amount for customer_report
payload_schema.reported_date: string (ISO 8601 UTC timestamp) — start of 5-business-day PSR SLA clock

consumers.action: Dispatches case confirmation push notification and email to PER-001 with case_reference and decision timeline.

For customer_report trigger: displays case confirmation screen in mobile app with case_reference and 5-business-day SLA. For realtime_block: updates the blocked payment status in the payment history view.
Creates immutable audit log entry. PSR regulatory evidence that case was opened within required timeframe.
Archives event to WORM store. 7-year retention (NFR-005-DATA-001). Start of regulatory evidence chain for this fraud case.

events.ordering_guarantees: Per-customer strict ordering via customer_id partition key on topic fraud.cases. One FraudCaseCreated per case_id — idempotency enforced by SVC-013 before publication.

events.name: FraudInvestigationStarted
events.trigger: FraudCase.status transitions from open to investigating. Occurs when a Fraud Analyst (PER-054) is assigned to the case and PATCH /fraud-cases/{id} is called with status=investigating. SLA gate: must occur within 4 hours of FraudCaseCreated (NFR-005-REG-002).

payload_schema.sla_deadline: string (ISO 8601 UTC timestamp) — computed: reported_date + 5 business days. Informational — downstream services use this for SLA monitoring.

consumers.action: Dispatches 'under investigation' in-app message to PER-001. Optional: if additional information is required from the customer, triggers secure evidence request message.
Creates audit entry recording analyst assignment timestamp. Used for SLA performance reporting.

events.ordering_guarantees: Per-case strict ordering via case_id partition key on topic fraud.cases. Strictly follows FraudCaseCreated for the same case_id.

events.name: FraudReimbursementApproved
events.trigger: POST /fraud-cases/{id}/decision is called with decision=approve or decision=partial. FraudCase.status transitions to reimbursed or partially_reimbursed. This is the primary cross-capability event of JRN-005 — it triggers both the customer account credit (SVC-001) and the receiving PSP recovery claim (SVC-009).

payload_schema.reimbursement_amount: number — GBP amount to credit. Max £85,000.
payload_schema.contributory_negligence_percentage: integer | null — present only when decision=partial
payload_schema.receiving_sort_code: string — 6-digit sort code of receiving PSP (for SVC-009 recovery claim routing)
payload_schema.fps_reference: string — FPS end-to-end reference (for SVC-009 recovery claim)

consumers.action: Credits reimbursement_amount to Account.account_id. Debits APP fraud loss suspense account. Publishes ReimbursementCredited (EVT-094). P99 < 30 minutes from event receipt (NFR-005-PERF-002). Idempotent on case_id.

Creates ReimbursementClaim (ENT-045) with sending_bank_share = reimbursement_amount * 0.5, receiving_bank_share = reimbursement_amount * 0.5. Submits recovery claim to receiving PSP via Pay.UK reimbursement API. Publishes RecoveryInitiated (EVT-095).
Dispatches regulated outcome letter (approve/partial) to PER-001 via email and push notification.
Creates immutable audit entry. PSR regulatory evidence of reimbursement approval decision and decided_at timestamp.
Archives event. Reimbursement approval is a financial record requiring 7-year WORM retention.

events.ordering_guarantees: Per-case strict ordering via case_id partition key on topic fraud.decisions. Strictly follows FraudInvestigationStarted for the same case_id. Mutually exclusive with FraudReimbursementDeclined for a given case_id.

events.name: FraudReimbursementDeclined
events.trigger: POST /fraud-cases/{id}/decision is called with decision=decline. FraudCase.status transitions to declined. Pre-condition: senior_manager_sign_off must be true. The gross_negligence_evidence field must be populated. Outcome letter to PER-001 is mandatory within 5 business days.

payload_schema.senior_manager_id: string (UUID v4) — the Senior Manager who co-signed the decline

consumers.action: Dispatches regulated outcome letter (decline) to PER-001 via email (mandatory channel). Content must include plain language explanation of gross negligence finding, FOS signpost, and 6-month complaint window. Consumer Duty non-deterrence requirement.
Creates immutable audit entry. Evidence that decline decision was made with Senior Manager co-sign. PSR regulatory compliance record.
Archives event. 7-year WORM retention — FOS evidence that decline was communicated within 5 business days.

events.ordering_guarantees: Per-case strict ordering on topic fraud.decisions. Mutually exclusive with FraudReimbursementApproved for a given case_id.

events.name: ReimbursementCredited
events.trigger: SVC-001 applies the reimbursement credit to the customer Account on consumption of FraudReimbursementApproved (EVT-092). The credit is applied as a standard credit transaction to Account.account_id with description 'APP Fraud Reimbursement — Case {case_reference}'. The event is published after the ledger credit is confirmed. P99 < 30 minutes from FraudReimbursementApproved receipt (NFR-005-PERF-002).

payload_schema.transaction_id: string (UUID v4) — internal account transaction identifier for the credit entry
payload_schema.sla_business_days_elapsed: integer — number of UK business days elapsed between FraudCase.reported_date and credited_at. Must be <= 5 for PSR compliance (NFR-005-REG-001).

consumers.action: Updates FraudCase.reimbursement_date to credited_at. SLA performance recorded (sla_business_days_elapsed). PSR quarterly reporting counter updated.
Dispatches push notification to PER-001: '£{credited_amount} APP Fraud Reimbursement credited to your account. Case {case_reference}. New balance: £{balance}'.
Creates immutable audit entry with sla_business_days_elapsed. Primary PSR SLA compliance evidence record.
Archives event. Financial record — 7-year retention. Demonstrates credit was applied within PSR SLA.

events.ordering_guarantees: Per-case strict ordering via case_id partition key on topic fraud.reimbursements. Strictly follows FraudReimbursementApproved for the same case_id.

events.name: RecoveryInitiated
events.trigger: SVC-009 creates a ReimbursementClaim entity and submits the recovery claim to the receiving PSP via Pay.UK's reimbursement API. Published after the Pay.UK claim reference is received and persisted in ReimbursementClaim.pay_uk_claim_reference.

payload_schema.pay_uk_claim_reference: string — Pay.UK reimbursement mechanism claim reference
payload_schema.receiving_bank_share: number — GBP amount claimed from receiving PSP (= reimbursement_amount * 0.5)

consumers.action: Records recovery initiation on FraudCase for case management visibility. Analyst can see recovery is in progress.
Creates audit entry. PSR regulatory requirement to evidence recovery attempt.
Archives event. PSR recovery attempt evidence.

events.ordering_guarantees: Per-case ordering via case_id partition key on topic fraud.recovery.

events.name: RecoveryCompleted
events.trigger: ReimbursementClaim.recovery_status transitions to full, partial, or failed — a terminal recovery state. Published when the receiving PSP responds to the recovery claim (return of funds) or when the claim is determined irrecoverable. Note: recovery_status=disputed is not a terminal state and does not trigger this event — dispute escalation is tracked separately.

payload_schema.recovery_amount: number — GBP. 0.00 for failed. Equal to receiving_bank_share for full.
payload_schema.net_bank_cost: number — GBP. sending_bank_share minus recovery_amount. The bank's actual net cost after recovery.

consumers.action: Updates FraudCase record with final recovery outcome for case closure and PSR quarterly reporting.
Creates audit entry with net_bank_cost. PSR quarterly reporting data source.
Archives event. Final financial record for the APP fraud claim.

events.ordering_guarantees: Per-case ordering on topic fraud.recovery. Follows RecoveryInitiated for the same case_id.

events.name: FraudCaseClosed
events.trigger: FraudCase.status transitions to closed. Occurs when the Fraud Analyst calls PATCH /fraud-cases/{id} with status=closed after all case activities are complete (reimbursement credited, recovery resolved). The WORM archive is triggered on consumption of this event.

payload_schema.final_decision: string enum (approved | partial | declined | no_action) — no_action for realtime_block cases with no reimbursement
payload_schema.sla_met: boolean — true if reimbursement_date was within 5 business days of reported_date (or no reimbursement required)

consumers.action: Triggers the full WORM archive job for this case: FraudCase + all FraudEvidence + associated events. 7-year retention from closed_at (NFR-005-DATA-001).
Dispatches case closure notification to PER-001 via in-app notification.
Creates final audit entry. PSR quarterly reporting counter incremented with final case outcome and sla_met flag.

events.ordering_guarantees: Per-case ordering on topic fraud.cases. Final event in the FraudCase event stream for a given case_id.

events.name: FraudPatternDetected
events.trigger: Published by SVC-013 at PH-070 (Case Closure) for every closed FraudCase, regardless of outcome. Contains anonymised pattern features derived from the investigation. These features are consumed by SVC-013's own ML model training pipeline to close the feedback loop between investigation outcomes and real-time detection accuracy.

payload_schema.case_id: string (UUID v4) — pseudonymised (hash to prevent correlation with customer records)
payload_schema.outcome: string enum (confirmed_fraud_reimbursed | confirmed_fraud_partial | declined_gross_negligence | declined_professional_fraud | false_positive_block | no_fraud_found)

pattern_features.payee_sort_code_risk_tier: string enum (known_mule | high_risk | medium_risk | low_risk | unknown)
pattern_features.warning_acknowledgement_count: integer — number of fraud/CoP warnings presented and acknowledged at payment time

payload_schema.model_version: string — current SVC-013 ML model version. Used to tag training data per model version.

consumers.action: Ingests pattern_features into the ML model training dataset. Confirmed fraud outcomes reinforce blocking signals. False positive blocks are used to improve precision. Gross negligence patterns improve the model's ability to distinguish high-risk-but-customer-fault cases from genuine victim cases.
Creates audit entry recording that ML feedback was published for this case. PRA SS1/23 (GOV-004-R01) model governance: training data provenance must be auditable.

events.ordering_guarantees: No strict ordering requirement. Pattern features are independent observations for the ML model. Published on a dedicated topic fraud.patterns.
events.retention: 5 years (ML training data retention for model governance under PRA SS1/23 GOV-004-R01)
